summary: Iteration 6 (staff phone-orders on Poste 1/2, /api/customers, /api/orders/{id}/assign + homepage hero redesign) validated end-to-end against the public preview URL. Backend: 17/17 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_phone_orders_iter6.py (run with -n 0). Covers: POST /api/customers creates customer with normalized phone + saved address (201); POST /api/phone-orders delivery Poste 1 cash -> status='accepted', source='telephone', station=1, payment_method='cash', user_id==customer.id, printed=true, print_attempts=1, estimated_minutes=30; GET /api/customers/search?phone=<7 digits> returns the account (with 1723 address) AND the phone order; pickup Poste 2 terminal has distinct order_number, both listed in /api/orders?active=true; pickup pay_at_pickup asap -> estimated_minutes=30 and ticket contains 'RETRAIT', 'TELEPHONE - POSTE 1', 'PAIEMENT AU RETRAIT'; delivery '19:45' -> ticket has 'LIVRAISON VERS 19:45' and 'SOUHAITE: 19:45' and requested_time stored; Diavola 32cm +lard -oignons note 'bien cuite' -> ticket has '- SANS OIGNONS', '+ LARD', 'NOTE: BIEN CUITE' and item persisted with extras/removed/note; mixed VAT (pizza + Bière Moretti) -> age_required=16 & age_confirmed=true, vat_breakdown has 2.6 and 8.1, ticket has 'CONTROLE AGE 16+', receipt contains 'TVA 2.6%', 'TVA 8.1%', 'CHE-156.631.035 TVA' and sum(net)+sum(vat)==total (2dp); GET /api/print-jobs returns exactly ONE kitchen job per phone-order id; POST /api/orders/{id}/print without force -> 409, with force:true -> 200 and print_attempts>=2. /assign: {'driver':'Livreur 2'} on delivery -> 200 driver='Livreur 2'; on pickup -> 400. Validation: station=3 -> 400; payment_method='bitcoin' -> 400. Regression: normal POST /api/orders still returns 'pending' printed=false; GET /api/menu ok. Frontend (Expo web, 1180x820 iPad-like): /phone-orders -> redirected to /staff/login -> PIN 1234 -> dashboard -> staff-go-phone-orders -> phone-station-picker visible on first use -> tap phone-station-1 -> header badge phone-station-badge = 'TÉLÉPHONE · POSTE 1'; after reload picker does NOT reappear (persisted via storage). phone-search-input with unknown phone -> phone-new-customer form -> filled first_name/street/npa/city -> phone-new-save -> phone-customer-card shows name. Delivery segment shows 4 phone-addr-* chips (saved address preselected) + phone-addr-text 'Rue Test 2 9, 1723 Marly'. phone-cat-boissons -> phone-product-* click adds line to phone-cart with phone-qty stepper. phone-cat-pizza -> phone-product-* opens /product/[id] modal -> size-option-32 -> add-to-cart-button -> returns with pizza line in cart. phone-time-exact -> phone-slot-* choice; phone-pay-terminal; phone-total renders CHF 14.00 (pickup order); phone-confirm -> phone-success modal, phone-success-number '#192', phone-success-ticket opens ticket screen containing 'HALLO MAGIC PIZZA', 'COMMANDE #192', 'RETRAIT', 'TELEPHONE - POSTE 1', 'PRET VERS 22:30', 'TERMINAL (CARTE)' and 'Imprimé 1x' banner (simulated). Staff dashboard filter 'En cours' shows badges 'TÉLÉPHONE · POSTE 1' and 'TÉLÉPHONE · POSTE 2' for both seeded orders. Opening the delivery Poste 1 phone order shows staff-assign-1/2/3 visible; clicking staff-assign-2 updates detail meta to 'Livreur 2' (also visible as 'ATTRIBUER UN LIVREUR · LIVREUR 2'). Homepage (390x844): home-hero renders with home-title 'Hallo Magic Pizza', kicker 'PIZZERIA · MARLY', sub 'Pizzas, piadine, pâtes et desserts italiens…', hero-order-now with label 'Commander maintenant', hero-photo (round Quattro Formaggi photo, no dark oven). NO 'feu de bois' in FR body and NO 'Holzofen' after switching to DE. OrderTypeSelector (RETRAIT/LIVRAISON) below hero. First product card visible within ~1.2 screen heights. No React Native red screen and no console errors during any of the flows.

integration_issues.issue: After creating a customer via phone-new-save and clicking phone-change-customer, re-typing the SAME phone digits in phone-search-input returns 0 phone-result-* entries (react-query cache miss on identical query key / stale accounts.length===0 branch keeps the phone-new-customer form). API /api/customers/search?phone=<digits> returns the customer correctly, so this is a client cache / debounce refresh issue on the phone-orders screen. Workaround: refetch the query when the customer is cleared, or bump the search key.

action_items: Minor: invalidate/reset the /api/customers/search react-query cache (or the debounced local phone state) inside CustomerPanel when the parent clears the selected customer via 'phone-change-customer', so re-searching the same digits re-fetches and shows phone-result-*.

Nothing else — feature fully working; the delivery Marly minimum (CHF 25) is correctly enforced from the phone-orders panel too (recap shows 'Minimum de commande pour la livraison (Marly): CHF 25.00' and disables phone-confirm).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_phone_order: forces age_confirmed=True server-side (comment explains handover-time ID check). Ticket + dashboard 16+/18+ warning still surface. Documented and tested.

server.py /assign: correctly rejects pickup (400) and preserves status when currently accepted/preparing/ready by only $setting driver; when status==ready or already assigned it pushes to 'assigned' via push_status. Good.
server.py /customers/search regex uses digits only (numeric) so unescaped regex is safe. r"\D*".join(digits) matches phones stored with formatting. Nice.
auth.py customers_router.create_customer: 409 on duplicate phone; sets password_hash=None and created_by='staff' — clean distinction from register().
phone-orders/index.tsx: STATION_KEY persisted via storage util; picker re-openable via phone-station-badge tap. Good UX.

customer-panel.tsx: emitting phone-addr-<id> chips + phone-addr-new + phone-addr-text/phone-addr-edit is nicely factored. Only concern: the search useQuery isn't manually refetched when the parent clears the customer (see integration issue).
order-panel.tsx: uses cart.orderType and only shows phone-pay-terminal/cash/pay_at_delivery|pay_at_pickup consistent with the order type — good.

(tabs)/index.tsx hero: photo is derived from the Quattro Formaggi product's admin-uploaded image_url via imgUri(); ring + round crop implemented via absolute-positioned View + Image. Accessible tap target (Pressable) on the photo navigates to /product/[id]. Good.
seed_data_creation: Pytest created ~8 TEST_* customers and phone/normal orders (all data prefixed 'TEST_'). Frontend session created customer TEST_FE (0796123456), TEST_FE2 (0796987654), TEST_Pick (0796456789) plus 4 phone orders (#191, #192 pickup Poste 1 terminal, #193 Poste 2 API-seeded, #194 delivery Poste 1 assigned to Livreur 2). Non-destructive, safe to leave.
